rec.name: Social Proof | Social Media Gallery (UGC Slider/Stack with Shoppable Cart Icon)
rec.status: Built — launched (tested internally by Kian: yes)

what.text: A standalone Shopify section that shows a community/UGC gallery of customer photos with Instagram handles. It has a headline (with optional highlighted/underlined word) and a subheadline. Two layouts are available: a horizontal Slider (arrows, scrollbar, optional pagination dots, caption bar with @handle under each image) and a Stack grid (multiple images per row). In the Stack layout, images that have linked products show a small cart icon with the product count at the bottom-left. Clicking it opens a modal listing the linked products (image, name, vendor, price, default variant, 'Show product' button to the PDP). Nothing is added to the cart directly. Instagram handles are displayed as text and, per the request, the link can be non-clickable so shoppers are not sent away from the store.

why.text: Real customer photos act as social proof: a large community number ('1.4 million community') and real people using the product reduce uncertainty and build belonging. Handles under images add authenticity. The shoppable cart icon turns inspiration into discovery by letting shoppers see which products are worn in a photo and jump straight to the PDP, shortening the path from inspiration to purchase. Keeping the handles non-clickable avoids leaking traffic to Instagram.

how.text: Create the section file ed-cro-social-gallery.liquid and two snippets (ed-cro-social-gallery-slider and ed-cro-social-gallery-stack). The section has 'heading' and 'content' blocks (font, color, size, alignment, max width, spacing for desktop/mobile, optional highlighted word with SVG underline). A 'layout_style' select (stack/slider) renders only the relevant snippet, so only the slider or stack JS loads, which improves page speed. Each image block holds the image, Instagram handle, and linked products. Configure the layout, items per row (desktop/mobile), gap, corner radius, caption and arrow colors, scrollbar, pagination and modal options in the theme customizer. Colors default to transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)) to fall back to global theme settings.

items: Layout: Stack or Slider
Heading block: text, highlighted word + SVG underline, font family, color, size, line height, letter spacing, alignment, text transform, max width, spacing (desktop/mobile)
Content/subheadline block: rich text, font, color, size, alignment, spacing (desktop/mobile)
Section text color and background color (fall back to theme globals if transparent)
Section top/bottom spacing (desktop/mobile) and optional custom max width
Stack: show cart icon, items per row (2–6, desktop/mobile), gap 0–16px, corner radius 0–16px
Stack modal: heading, arrows, show vendor/price/default variant, view button on/off + text, content background, background opacity
Slider: items per row (2–6, desktop/mobile), gap, corner radius
Slider caption color and background
Slider arrows: show/hide, background, active background
Slider scrollbar: show/hide, color, active color
Slider pagination: show/hide, color, active color
Images (min. 4) with Instagram handle per image, ordering, responsive sizing
Background image with positioning and overlay color (from the acceptance criteria)
Cart icon position bottom-left or bottom-right (from the acceptance criteria)

dependencies.text: Needs a theme with global color settings (settings.heading_color, settings.text_color, settings.background) and a '.container' wrapper class. Requires the two snippets (ed-cro-social-gallery-slider and ed-cro-social-gallery-stack) and JS for the slider and stack/modal. Images with linked products need a product link per image block (product picker). The code file shown was truncated, so the block schema and snippets could not be fully verified. No external app is needed.

items: Scroll depth / section view rate on the homepage
Slider interaction rate (arrow clicks, swipes)
Cart icon click rate and modal open rate
Click-through rate from modal to PDP
Add-to-cart rate and revenue per session for sessions that interacted
Homepage bounce rate and exit rate
Conversion rate vs. control

images.caption: Original reference (Dope Snow): headline 'Join the 1.4 million Dope Snow community', horizontal slider with UGC photos, Instagram handles under each image, next arrow and scrollbar.
Cart icon with product count at the bottom-left of images that have linked products (e.g., 2 and 1).
Built Slider layout: headline with highlighted underlined word 'Community', subheadline, images with @handle caption bar, arrow, pagination dots and scrollbar.
Built Stack layout: grid of 4 images per row with rounded corners, small gaps, and cart-icon badges showing the linked product count.
